words.gloss: let one bear or carry on shoulders
the end time or time of ruin

literal: If one sees enemies, let one bear them; if one sees their end time, their head will become downward.
translation: When you meet your enemies, bear with them and carry them on your shoulders; when their end-time arrives, their heads will fall headlong.
modern: பகைவர்களைக் கண்டால் அவர்களைப் பொறுத்துக் கொண்டு தோளில் சுமக்க வேண்டும்; அவர்களது இறுதிக்காலம் வரும்போது, அவர்களது தலை கீழே விழும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the strategic importance of patience and timing when dealing with powerful adversaries. The term 'சுமக்க' (bear/carry) advises a person to patiently tolerate and even humor their enemies, acting with submissiveness as if carrying them on their shoulders. This is not weakness, but a calculated delay until the right moment. When the enemies' destined time of ruin ('இறுவரை') finally arrives, their downfall will be automatic and complete, described vividly as their heads falling headlong ('கிழக்காம் தலை').
